basic_details.post_name: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Intern (RI)

qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): B.E./B.Tech. degree or three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Research Intern (RI): Pursuing B.E./B.Tech. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Preference for both posts: Experience in robotics, underwater systems, sensors, control or system integration.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): As per UGC Research Intern (RI): Rs. 6000/month

selection_process: Screening of applications based on eligibility Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Delhi University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 2 for Research Intern (RI).

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): B.E./B.Tech. degree or three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Research Intern (RI): Pursuing B.E./B.Tech. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent. Preference for both posts: Experience in robotics, underwater systems, sensors, control or system integration.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): As per UGC Research Intern (RI): Rs. 6000/month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Delhi University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Delhi University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Intern (RI) posts is 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF and RI posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by Delhi University for the positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Research Intern (RI).

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Research Intern (RI) position?
faq.answer: For the Research Intern (RI) position, candidates must be pursuing a B.E./B.Tech. degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, or IT engineering or an equivalent field.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Delhi University recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications based on eligibility criteria, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Research Intern (RI) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Intern (RI) position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 6000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for Delhi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these positions through email only.

faq.question: Q8. Does Delhi University offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the preferred experience for these roles?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in robotics, underwater systems, sensors, control, or system integration.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
